rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill. It has front matter with `name` and `description`, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.references`.

The requirement says each link to a file of specialized material MUST say when to read that file. The skill has two such links, and each one says when:
- `references/distributed-requirements.md`: "For an obligation that applies separately at each of many sites… read [it] before drafting it, and whenever you edit a `{req}` that contains `{sites}` or `{violations}`."
- `references/syntax-details.md`: "If a file that implements or tests a requirement cannot carry a comment, such as a shipped skill or a stylesheet copied into other projects, or a requirement lives in a nested chapter, read [it]."

The skill also mentions the habeas-evidence skill's `references/fixme.md`. That mention is a code span, not a link. It also points to a file in a different skill. It still has a trigger: it comes right after the sentence on `{fixme}` acknowledging a deferred gap. So it breaks nothing.

The site has no violation matches to judge. It meets the requirement.

text: A bundled skill MAY put material needed only in specialized situations in files it links to. Each such link MUST say when to read the file. Each bundled skill, recognized by its front matter, is a site:
